```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| label: fig-flowchart
%%| fig-cap: "Flowchart diagram of the *Light therapy* use case."

flowchart TD

%% ===== Setup =====
P[Load packages]

%% ===== Light data stream =====
LFILE[Define light path files pattern tz]
LDATA[Import ActLumus light data into data]
LQC[Check gaps and irregulars with gap_table]
LPLOT[Quick light plot with gg_day and gg_photoperiod]

LFILE --> LDATA
LDATA --> LQC
LDATA --> LPLOT

%% ===== Log data stream =====
EFILE[Read Excel logs into state_data]
EPREP[Rename columns build Datetime pivot to start and end per state]
EOVERVIEW[Overview table of state intervals with gt]

EFILE --> EPREP
EPREP --> EOVERVIEW

%% ===== Combine light and logs =====
KEEP[Define states_to_keep]
MERGE[Add states to light data with add_states]
STATEFAC[Factor and recode state labels in data]

LDATA --> KEEP
KEEP --> MERGE
EPREP --> MERGE
MERGE --> STATEFAC

%% ===== Compare conditions – histogram =====
HIST[Density ridge histogram of MEDI by state and participant]

STATEFAC --> HIST

%% ===== Compare conditions – tables =====
TABLE_EP[Episode based metrics  extract_states  extract_metric  summarize_numeric]

STATEFAC --> TABLE_EP

DPREP[Prepare data_prep drop missing states and group by state]
DUR[Calculate durations by state with durations]
METRIC[State based mean and dose with extract_metric]
COMPTBL[Build wide comparison table data_tbl_comparison]
GT[Styled comparison table with gt formatting and grand totals]

STATEFAC --> DPREP
DPREP --> DUR
DUR --> METRIC
METRIC --> COMPTBL
COMPTBL --> GT

%% ===== Compare conditions – plots =====
PREPAX[Prepare protocol axis times and symbol metadata]
TSERIES[Timeline plot of MEDI by state and participant]
CUMDOSE[Cumulative dose plot over time using derived dose]

STATEFAC --> PREPAX
PREPAX --> TSERIES
PREPAX --> CUMDOSE
```
